summary.text: Chris Elliott, a Republican, has represented District 32 in the Alabama State Senate since November 7, 2018, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: Elliott graduated from St. Paul's Episcopal School and earned a bachelor's degree in political science and urban policy from the University of Richmond in Virginia.
His career experience includes working in emergency management for the Commonwealth of Virginia, and he served on the board of directors of Baldwin County United Way.
